principle: Keep current/future product protection active; keep useful operations support nonblocking; preserve history without automatic compute.

concepts.reason: Measures accepted end-to-end two-manager capability evidence for the current milestone.
Measures current milestone feature lifecycle delivery maturity; distinct from SSJR evidence.
Completed 100/100 milestone; preserve evidence but do not recalculate or gate unrelated current work.
Adaptive 2-20 failed correction/validation budget protects quality without a fixed two-failure stop.
Underlying context observations remain useful to ADB; visible percentage retired from normal operation.
Five transfer conditions are useful; 0/20/40/60/80/100 score is not.
Keep exact recoverable state; stop score/archival/continuity cycles from becoming milestones.
Smart Lean Efficient remains valuable; mirrored/versioned packaging ritual retired.
One compact successor snapshot at an actual transfer; no after-every-task artifacts.
No source mechanism identified; do not invent a gate.
Duplicated durable state and generated documentation churn without product protection.
Superseded by product-focused SSJR/MDP reporting and session health only when relevant.
Preserve prior files but do not generate/read by default.
Preserve prior files but no mirrored-copy requirement under POS-2.
Large accumulated provenance remains available; new startup uses current guards/task/metrics.
Useful recovery provenance, not default startup context or automatic append milestone.
Stable current provider/product/privacy safety invariants without prose coupling.
Makes every blocking current product test explicit and separates operations/history.

gateClasses.PRODUCT_CRITICAL: Blocking when protecting current/future runtime, UI/UX, data, recovery, security, privacy, provider safety, executable authority, evidence validity or release correctness.
gateClasses.CURRENT_ENGINEERING_QUALITY: Blocking when relevant; deduplicate expensive suite ownership.
gateClasses.OPERATIONS_CONTINUITY: Nonblocking for unrelated product work; run when the operating tooling changes.
gateClasses.HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE: Manual/on-demand only; preserve evidence without automatic product compute.
